title: Four header tiles filter, count assets, and don't add up
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. Seed rows with day intervals and BLANK last service dates (a date typed at enrolment rests the row until its first reminder, so it would not be listed): a schedule "Tile check" with "D10" Every 10 days, "D20" Every 20 days, "D45" Every 45 days, "D80" Every 80 days and "NR" Every 30 days + Distance Every 15,000 mileage; enrol two test assets on it with blank dates (asset 2 must have no mileage reading so NR is a Needs readings row). For Overdue rows enrol a third asset on a schedule "Late check" with "L30" Every 30 days and last service date 100 days before today (it fell due 70 days ago and has missed several 30-day cycles; its reminder is reached, so it is listed).
custom_steps:
1. Read the four header tiles and their labels.
  2. Note the colour treatment of the Overdue tile against the others.
  3. Click a tile to filter, then click it again.
  4. Click a second tile as well.
  5. Check what each tile counts (assets or rows) and whether the tiles sum to a total.
  6. Find a service that missed several cycles and count its rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The header has four tiles: Overdue (due before today), Due in a month (today up to 30 days ahead), Due in 3 months (31-91 days ahead) and Needs readings; each counts assets, an asset with rows in two tiles counts once in each, so the tiles do not add up to a total.
  • Tiles act as filters, all with the same visual treatment - no colour singles out Overdue.
  • Clicking a tile filters the list; clicking it again clears it; more than one tile may be active at once.
  • A service appears once however many cycles it has missed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (unchanged requirements); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
